name: Ocal Browser v10.1.24 Stable
body:
## Ocal Browser v10.1.24 — Release Notes & Update Catalog

### InPrivate Browsing Suite Overhaul
* **Flat Shadowless Theme**: Redesigned InPrivate window and home tab using solid Deep Petrol (`#1e2b33`) and Terracotta Coral (`#f87d51`) without gradients or drop shadows.
* **56px Rounded Rectangular Command Bar**: Replaced oval pill search bar with a modern 16px-radius search bar, framed squircle emblem badge (`36x36px`), and integrated squircle action button (`42x38px`).
* **Space-Between Quadrant Alignment**: Spaced quadrant card headers (ISP Cloak, IP Mask, Tracker Neutralizer, Zero Local Footprint) matching reference design without overlapping text.

### Unrestricted Stealth Browsing & Barrier Removal
* **Zero Filter Interception**: Completely bypassed adult content filtering, mindful shield redirects, and forced SafeSearch injection in private mode.
* **Streamlined Exit Flow**: Removed intrusive confirmation popups on single-tab close and added 'Don't ask again' preference for window closure.

### Site Permissions & Modal Refinements
* **High-Contrast Toggle Switches**: Bright white/slate switch knobs (`#ffffff` / `#e2e8f0`) on dark petrol backgrounds for immediate visibility.
* **Shadowless Container & Clean Buttons**: Clean sentence-case 'Reset permissions' button and instant origin authorization storage.

### Full Active Tab Accent Harmonization
* **Solid Tab Highlighting**: Full vibrant accent color applied directly to the active browser tab with solid backgrounds across light and dark themes.

### Signed Production Artifacts
* `Ocal-10.1.24-Setup.exe` (SHA-256 Signed Win32 Inno Setup Executable)
* `Ocal Browser 10.1.24.msix` & `Ocal Browser 10.1.24.appx` (Signed Microsoft Store Packages)
* `GamingNetworkStudioMediaGroup.cer` (Official Public Publisher Certificate)
